name: ryu.composio-connect
description: Connect Ryu to Composio's hosted For You MCP server with OAuth. The connection exposes Composio's connected-app tools without requiring a Composio API key; Ryu still applies its own tool allowlists and approval policy.

composio_connect.description: Composio Connect — hosted MCP access to connected third-party apps. Authorize the account from Marketplace → Connections before using its tools.
